children: Global analytics software leader,
FICO (

today announced that Xactus®, the market leader in verification solutions, will make the FICO® Preferred Program available to all mortgage industry clients. The agreement also extends access to mortgage credit reseller clients served through the XedaLink® and SharperLending platforms.
This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261120597969/en/

Through the monthly FICO Preferred Program, participating lenders can access the Classic FICO® Score and FICO® Score 10T for a $10 wholesale price per bureau, per borrower, for the bundled scores (FICO wholesale price unchanged for 2027). The Classic FICO Score has served as the industry standard in mortgage lending for nearly three decades, while FICO Score 10T provides the most predictive credit score available to the mortgage industry.

“Through our expanded relationship with FICO, Xactus, including XedaLink, and SharperLending, will be ready on January 1, 2027 to support our client’s ability to select and use FICO scores available through the FICO Preferred Program,” said
Shelley Leonard, President of Xactus
. “Our focus is on providing greater choice and flexibility to our clients and ultimately the end consumer, expanding access to homeownership.”

FICO Scores support more precise mortgage pricing, helping borrowers secure competitive loan terms based on their individual credit profile while supporting the safety and soundness of the housing finance system. By lenders incorporating FICO Scores, borrowers can save over $3,500 or more per loan, driving better loan pricing and secondary market execution benefits.
“We designed our new pricing models to give lenders additional choices on how to license FICO Scores to drive greater choice in the mortgage ecosystem,” said
Julie May, President of B2B Scores at FICO

. “Together with Xactus and XedaLink, we’re putting that choice into action across the market. We appreciate their commitment to proactively supporting change in the mortgage industry to enable the FICO Scores – including FICO Score 10T, which will create more opportunities for the industry to enable sustainable homeownership.”
Lenders interested in accessing the FICO Preferred Program through Xactus can contact their Xactus representative.
For more information on the FICO Preferred Program, visit
https://www.ficoscore.com/fico-preferred-program
About FICO
FICO (

) powers decisions that help people and businesses around the world prosper. Founded in 1956, the company is a pioneer in the use of predictive analytics and data science to improve operational decisions. FICO holds more than 200 U.S. and foreign patents on technologies that increase profitability, customer satisfaction and growth for businesses in financial services, insurance, telecommunications, health care, retail and many other industries. Using FICO solutions, businesses in more than 70 countries do everything from protecting 4 billion payment cards from fraud, to improving financial inclusion, to increasing supply chain resiliency. The FICO® Score, used by 90% of top U.S. lenders, is the standard measure of consumer credit risk in the U.S. and has been made available in over 40 other countries, improving risk management, credit access and transparency.
Learn more at https://www.fico.com.
About Xactus

Xactus is a leading verification innovator advancing intelligent verification across financial services. Through its proprietary Intelligent Verification Platform®, Xactus360, the company delivers advanced data and technology solutions that help organizations make better decisions faster while increasing efficiency and reducing operational waste. With a focus on automation, accuracy, and innovation, Xactus continues to modernize verification and improve outcomes across complex decisioning environments.

About XedaLink

XedaLink is a web-based order fulfillment hub that streamlines mortgage credit and verification data ordering from application to closing. Through its flexible, easy-to-use platform, XedaLink brings together powerful tools and seamless integrations that help lenders simplify workflows, increase efficiency and reduce risk. With a focus on simplicity and connectivity, XedaLink helps lenders move faster and deliver better outcomes throughout the mortgage process.
